definitions.host_gate: A host-owned synchronous decision boundary before native compaction and every provider attempt.
definitions.dispatch_binding: One decision bound to one complete request, context generation and budget observation.
definitions.unsupported_path: A path that must stop under strict recycling until its request and growth bounds are established.

product.outcome: Make Codex wait for ARE before compaction and model execution

business.hypothesis: Preserve the existing host workflow while making context growth controllable

requirements: Cover lower HTTP retries and auth recovery
Handle or reject incremental WebSocket state
Stop native compaction paths before execution
No production host or login changes during construction

open_questions: Can the pinned upstream build resolve its complete dependency graph?
Which boundary exposes a full logical request and effective model limits?
How will native task handover settle pending tools?
